shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Levels and per-level size are bought from a fixed 146,000-cell budget; per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine, with snow, altitude weather and windier peaks. Coast, river and lake tiles supported; Dubs Mint Minimap and Map Preview both patched.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED**. ~66 files / ~17,800 LOC.

## Pitch
Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

> **QOL pass VERIFIED (#172). §6b-LAKE closed as vanilla appearance.**
> **ALTITUDE PASS (§7/§16) largely verified: snow clamps to land, seeds at generation, readout and turbines fixed.**
> **SETTINGS PASS (§17) WRITTEN, BUILD GREEN, UNTESTED.**

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`; bands along **+z**; permanently-fogged gutter between bands; `Slot = ceil((bandHeight+2)/64)×64` — **64-alignment is load-bearing**. Per-level sizes 126 / 190 / 254.
**⚠ THE STACK IS 2-7× ANISOTROPIC.** Any vanilla system normalising by BOTH map dimensions is distorted. First suspect for any "smeared/stretched" symptom.

### The one insight
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum; `Reachability.CanReach` works **unpatched**. **But reachability ≠ a path** — 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE — six shapes now
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| **Anchor** — a point picked as a fraction of `Size.z` | river / lake centre; random/edge cell (§15a) | remap the point |
| **Field** — a gradient centred on the map centre | coastline (§6e) | re-centre the sample coordinate |
| **Noise space** — a slice ≠ a short map | Map Preview (§6d) | generate at full height, then crop |
| **Distance-to-extent** — a margin measured off `Size` | `CloseToEdge`, no-build edge (§15b/§15d) | re-base onto the cell's own band rect |
| **Aspect ratio** — normalised by BOTH dims | water surface (§6b-LAKE) | *none — cosmetic, accepted* |
| **⚠ MAP-WIDE SCALAR** — one per-tick value for the whole map | snow melt (§7), the temperature readout (§16) | **rewrite it per cell at the consumer** |
**Classify a new bug into one of these six — but PROVE it.** Still unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — cell budget = **146,000, FIXED**
`4 × 190 = 145,920` sets the figure; `5 × 190` and `3 × 254` refused. `ABMapSizeLimit` owns it.
**Per-level size is SQUARE (`Size.x == bandHeight`)** — why `GenStep_Scatterer.CountFromPer10kCells` (squaring `Size.x`, not `map.Area`) already yields a per-BAND count.
**⚠ THE LEVEL CHOOSER IS ALSO THE LAB.** `0 above / 0 below` = an ORDINARY single-level map, the vanilla control. Band count sets `Size.z`, so it is a **calibrated aspect dial**: 1 band = 1.00, 2 = 2.02, 4 = 4.04.
**⚠ STILL UNVERIFIED: does `0 up / 0 down` actually apply?** #174 was launched to be that control and produced 190×768 anyway. **Pre-flight: the strip must read 1 level / 36,100 cells.**

### ⚠ THE CHOOSER UI — own the widget, don't patch the data
**`Dialog_AdvancedGameConfig.MapSizes` is `static readonly` and the reflection swap SILENTLY FAILED in play.** The postfix also re-snapped `GameInitData.mapSize` **every frame**. **Now:** our own radio buttons write `mapSize` directly. Window grown via an `InitialSize` postfix.

# 3. CROSS-BAND MOVEMENT
Segmented at ONE interception: `StartPath` prefix → tick sweep → `Carry` re-issues `StartPath`. `ABWormhole.TryGetTransit` **BFSes the band graph**; hops must strictly decrease. **Multi-hop STILL UNTESTED IN PLAY.**

# 4. GROUP ORDERING
`RecomputeDestinations` spreads the selection along the drag line, which between bands runs through the GUTTER. Odd/even signature is the proof: only ODD counts sample exactly 0.5. **Verified.**

# 5. ⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE — `ABBands.TryResolveVisibleBelow`
**NINE systems share it. SEVEN appearances of the single-`- Slot` bug. VERIFIED FIXED (#168).**
**Sun-shadow subtlety:** its mask is *neighbour*-based, so mask and descent are answered together by `TryResolveDropAround`, taking the **smallest** drop among the nine cells.
**Still single-band:** the realtime-things pass in `ABBelowDynamicDraw` (motes, fire).

# 6. SKY-MASS PRESENTATION — verified in play
**⚠ FOUR REJECTED ATTEMPTS:** force-linked wall masks · high-queue cover · wall-sprite suppression · theorising twice about "flat" mountains before running the below-layer report.
Despeckle (**wall dissolves only at 7+ open neighbours**) · one central fog hole · five-terrain plateau palette · cliff faces · alpine pass.
**⚠ THE MASS TAPERS WITH ALTITUDE, so +3 may contain NO LAND AT ALL** — mistaken for "snow is broken at +3" in #178. Check for ground before diagnosing anything about the top level.
**Ore glyph bug:** ore defs have no `naturalTerrain` ⇒ a "can't happen" fallback drew the whole **atlas sheet** per cell.

# 6b. ⚠ WATER — **1.6 water is a TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE effect**
`SectionLayer_Watergen` (**`internal`**) is `SectionLayer_Terrain` + `waterDepthMaterial`, drawn to the **WaterDepth SUBCAMERA's** layer; the visible `Map/TerrainWater` samples that at its own SCREEN position.
- **Water from upper levels — FIXED (#171)** via `SectionLayer_ABBelowWatergen` overriding `DrawLayer` to the subcamera layer.
- **Rivers — FIXED.** Remap `GetRiverCenter` (not `Init`); **`GetLakeCenter` needs the same patch or it undoes the first**.
- **Flow path is band-correct and PROVEN IRRELEVANT** to the streaking.

# 6b-LAKE. **CLOSED — surface streaking accepted as vanilla appearance.**
**PROVEN (#173):** a tile with `riverGraph 0 · riverFlowMap NULL · water=580 · baseRiver=0` **still streaked**. No flow data exists ⇒ flow cannot be the cause. **Ghost-river theory dead.** Root cause never established; user decision: fine, stop.

# 6c/6d/6e. COMPAT + COASTS — all VERIFIED
Dubs: **ONE RECT, NOT SEVEN PATCHES**; `DrawTextureFitted` preserves the TEXTURE's aspect, use `StretchToFill`. Map Preview: generate at full stacked height, crop via `TexCoords`; `MaxMapSize.z` MUST rise. Coasts: **CENTRED wrong, not scaled wrong** — `z' = (z % Slot) + (map.Size.z - bandHeight) / 2`, **NO SCALING**; nine mutators, none override `GetNoiseValue`.

# 7. PER-LEVEL CHARACTER
Ore `×(1+0.45×(depth-1))`, cave openness `×(1+0.35×(depth-1))`, both AFTER the settings clamp.

### ⚠ THE SNOW LINE NEVER WORKED, AND THE COMMENT SAYING IT DID NOT NEED TO WAS WRONG
Seeding was deleted because *"vanilla melts snow using each CELL's own temperature"*. **False.** `SteadyEnvironmentEffectsTick` computes `outdoorMeltAmount = MeltAmountAt(map.mapTemperature.OutdoorTemp)` **once per tick for the whole map**. It never calls `TryGetTemperatureForCell` — the only thing the offset patches. Snow line dead for months behind a confident, wrong sentence.

### Climate is now PER COLONY, not per settings file (§17)
Defaults **+1 −7 / +2 −16 / +3 −35**, basement flat **−6**, wind **×1.15/1.30/1.50**. `+2` is the seasonal line, `+3` a permanent cap that a desert or heat wave can still thaw. **No ceiling clamp** — melt must stay a consequence of real temperature.

# 8. CAMERA
`ABCameraBounds.For(level)` keyed by **level**; **`maxZoom` DERIVED**; **`panMargin` 63.5 on EVERY level — VERIFIED (#172).** Calibration dialog opens with the clamp UNLOCKED.

# 9. ⚠ GENERATION COST — top open item
| Run | Tile | Carve | band1 | band2 | band3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #173 | bog | 2.3 s | — | — | — |
| #174 | mountainous | 17.1 s | 3.6 | **8.5** | 4.8 |
| #175 | mountainous | 17.4 s | **10.9** | 3.3 | 2.7 |
| #176 | mountainous | 18.5 s | 10.7 | 4.4 | 2.8 |
**⚠ BIOME CONTENT, NOT CELL COUNT** — 7.4× spread at identical size. **Any carve timing MUST record the tile.**
**⚠ FALSIFIED: "band 1 is consistently ~3× bands 2-3."** #174 and #175 are the same config with **reversed** distributions. Per-band cost is a property of where that tile's noise put rock, not of band index. **The doomed-band skip must scope ALL non-surface bands uniformly and cannot be tuned per band.**
**`Sky clear` ~97% of the carve**; `0 rocks spawned`. `SeedAltitudeSnow` costs **17.8 ms** — free.
**HARD CONSTRAINT: per-cell gensteps scope safely; `map.Area`-count scatterers do NOT** (the scatterer family counts off `Size.x²`, so it is safe). **Do not blanket-skip the water/coast mutators.**

# 10-11. PERF / LINKS — 59.6 fps @96 pawns, mod ≈2% frame. Elevator SHIPPED, untested.

# 12. DIAGNOSTICS
band info · below layer/pawn reports · **water report** · transit health · stuck probe · shader/biome reports · bisect toggles · ABGenProfile · camera calibration.
**⚠ Bisect toggles PERSIST across runs** — #172 opened with `belowWater=False` from an earlier session, mimicking a fixed bug exactly. **Read the bisect line before trusting any water/snow observation.**
**⚠ POLL THE MONITOR EVEN WHEN NOTHING PROMPTS** — single-occurrence `[RimWorld]` warnings are filtered, and two scatterer starvation warnings surfaced only that way (§15b).

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **Play-test the settings pass (§17).**
2. **Doomed-band genstep scoping pass** (§9) — uniform across non-surface bands; the band-1 heuristic is dead.
3. **Verify `0 up / 0 down` reaches generation** (§2).
4. **Audit the other `FalloffAtAngle` mutators.**
5. **Never exercised:** multi-hop stair router, elevator, reload fix. **Basement paths untested** — every run since #172 has been 3-up/0-down.
6. Realtime-things pass single-band · selection bracket drifts on zoom-out · waterfalls · COMBAT never verified · compat audit · **store page still says three levels**.

# 14. LESSONS (telegraphic)
**PROVE A SUBSYSTEM INNOCENT BY FINDING A STATE WHERE THE SUSPECT CANNOT EXIST** · **a documented rejection may be re-opened ONLY by naming the confound** · **change ONE thing per experiment** · **not every bug has a bug** · **⚠ A COMMENT ASSERTING WHY SOMETHING IS SAFE TO DELETE IS A CLAIM, NOT A FACT** · **RE-MEASURE THE ASSUMPTION YOU ARE ABOUT TO BUILD ON** · **⚠ VERIFY THE BRANCH IS EVEN TAKEN BEFORE PATCHING IT** — the readout fix scoped a postfix onto `OutdoorTemp`, which `TemperatureString` NEVER reaches, because outdoor cells still belong to a Room and `Room.Temperature` is a stored field; it applied cleanly and fired never · **look for MAP-WIDE SCALARS** · **when a shared per-tick field is rewritten per cell, rewrite it on EVERY cell including the default case** · **patch the idempotent READ, not the cached WRITE** — `DesiredPowerOutput` is safe, a field refreshed every 250 ticks compounds · **check whether vanilla reads the CACHED field or the LIVE property** · **DEFAULTS MATTER: `TerrainDef.holdSnowOrSand` defaults TRUE**, so custom void terrain collects snow unless told not to · **a spatial helper that reaches 22 rows will cross a 2-row gutter** (wind path) · **an EXACT number is a diagnosis** · **use the product's own knobs as lab equipment** · **a beautiful fit is not evidence** · **A STACKED MAP IS 2-7× ANISOTROPIC** · **ALTITUDE IS DRAW ORDER** (`WorldClipper` > `Skyfaller`) · **`Banded` is FALSE for the whole of map generation** · **a null global texture falls back to the SHADER'S default, not zero** · **snapshot generated-world parameters onto the map, never read them live from settings** · **two runs of the same config are only comparable if the TILE matches** · **find the ONE virtual everything funnels through** · **never put a foreign type in a patch-class signature** · **re-centre, don't rescale** · **grep every `- Slot`** · **own the widget instead of patching the data it reads** · **"can't happen" fallbacks are what the player photographs** · **balance GUI clip/group pops in a `finally`** · statics keyed by game-scoped ids leak — CWT · **any type with a `Material` field needs `[StaticConstructorOnStartup]`** · never cache comps while Scribe active · FinalizeInit = worker thread · `SectionLayer` subclasses are **auto-discovered**.

---

# 15. QOL PASS — **VERIFIED (#172)**
**15a. Nothing may exist in the void** — `ABBandSafety.cs`. Finders (`RandomEdgeCell(Rot4,Map)`, 5-arg `TryFindRandomEdgeCellWith`, `RandomCell`) answer inside the SURFACE band; prefix on the **7-arg `GenSpawn.Spawn`** rewrites `loc`; a **120-tick sweep** catches teleports and old saves. **Always relocates to the surface.**
**15b. Structures must not straddle a seam** — `CloseToEdge` re-based onto the cell's own band rect; eleven cold call sites inherit it. Backstop: `GenStep_Scatterer.CanScatterAt` postfix (base reaches the family). **⚠ The seam margin is now DERIVED (`bandHeight/24`, clamped 4-12)** — a flat 10 starved scatterers on small bands; two reported "could not find cell to generate at" across three maps.
**15c. Camera bounds** — `panMargin` 63.5 on every level.
**15d. No-build map edge REMOVED on banded maps** — per-band is one flag away (`ABNoBuildEdge.Removed`). **Consequence:** vanilla's strip is also what stops a colony sealing its map edge.
**15e. Drop pods fall through the levels** — suppress `Skyfaller.DrawAt`, re-issue via `DrawNowAt` translated by `(viewedBand - itsBand) * Slot`. **Altitude chosen per frame** or landings render at full brightness through the night lighting overlay.

# 16. ALTITUDE / WEATHER — `ABBandWeather.cs`
**ONE WeatherManager per Map**, so weather is **not simulated per band; it is one weather INTERPRETED per band.**
**Snow confined to real ground:** `AB_OpenAir` + `AB_WallTop` → `holdSnowOrSand=false`. Wall tops match vanilla walls, which hold no snow.
**Melt per band:** prefix on `DoCellSteadyEffects` rewrites the private `outdoorMeltAmount` — **on EVERY call including level 0**, or a surface cell inherits whatever the last sky cell installed.
**Snow must EXIST before it can persist:** `SeedAltitudeSnow` at generation, depth scaled by how far below freezing, seeded from the CURRENT temperature so a winter start finds the line lower. Justified now only because melt is band-aware — it seeds the equilibrium and hands control back.
**Rain falls AND draws as snow above the line.** Accumulation via the public `AddFallenSnowAt` (field-forcing fails: vanilla gates on the cached field but takes the amount from the LIVE property). Drawing substitutes a snow overlay for the rain one, **colour copied off the rain overlay SkyManager just tinted**, so dusk/night/fade come out right by construction. **Rejected:** swapping `WeatherDef.Worker.overlays` — one swap would fix both consumers, but that list is a global Def shared across maps.
**No overlays underground.** Judged on the viewed band; overlays are screen-space.
**Wind ×1.15/1.30/1.50, 0 underground.** Patched on the `DesiredPowerOutput` **getter** — a CompTick postfix would re-multiply a field refreshed every 250 ticks. **Wind path fix:** `CalculateWindCells` spans 22 rows and the gutter is 2, so turbines were blocked by a mountain on a *different level*; blocked cells outside the turbine's band are now dropped.
**Readout:** `GlobalControls.TemperatureString` rebuilt in a postfix from `TryGetTemperatureForCell`. `Room.Temperature` is band-blind but harmless — `Thing.AmbientTemperature` routes through `GetTemperatureForCell`, so pawns really do feel altitude.

# 17. SETTINGS PASS — **BUILD GREEN, UNTESTED**
**Tabbed + scrolling window:** Performance · Climate · Sky · Basement · Diagnostics. `TabDrawer` paints its row ABOVE the rect given, so the body starts 32px down. Scroll height is measured from the previous frame's `list.CurHeight` — it lags one frame, invisibly, as every scrolling panel in the game does.
**The unlock gate.** The checkbox writes to a LOCAL; `unclampMapSize` only becomes true inside a `Dialog_MessageBox.CreateConfirmation` callback, so the stored value *is* the record that the warning was read. Turning it back off is never gated. While unlocked: a red banner on the tab, and the colony-creation strip shows the **multiple over budget**. That strip colours against the BUDGET, not against `Fits()` — once unlocked `Fits()` is unconditionally true, which is exactly when the warning matters most.
**The budget stays a `const`, deliberately.** A slider invites nudging, and every nudge lands the player further into unsupported territory without the dialog ever firing.
**Climate is SNAPSHOTTED onto `ABBandMap` at generation** (`SnapshotClimate`, scribed, called beside `Setup` on both carve paths). Reading live settings would re-climate every existing save — a slider drag would melt the snow line of a three-year-old colony. Resolution order: snapshot → settings → hardcoded defaults, so pre-snapshot saves and mid-generation calls still answer. Past the table it extrapolates at the last step.
**Always 3 up / 3 down shown**, whatever the current plan, so a layout can be tuned before it is chosen. Presets Gentle / Standard / Alpine. Each slider previews the resulting temperature against the live map (or 20 °C in the menu) — an offset alone means nothing, "20 °C becomes −15 °C here" does.

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true`, `quicktest=false`. **Compat tests need the target mod as a companion** — Dubs and Map Preview are both INACTIVE in the user's real list. **Note the tile in any perf comparison.** **A `surfaceBand=0` config cannot exercise band-folded addressing.** **Check the bisect line before trusting a water/snow observation.**
